entities.name: Dillon Dubé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dillon Dubé is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who plays forward for the Springfield Thunderbirds of the American Hockey League (AHL). Dubé was selected by the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL) 56th overall in the 2016 NHL entry draft. He also played for Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League.
